description.zh-CN: 检测模型输出里的短句复读，命中后中断这次回复；相同请求随后在冷却期内被拒绝。只检查文字与推理增量，不读取提示词、工具参数和凭证。
description.zh-TW: 偵測模型輸出中的短句複讀，命中後中斷這次回覆；相同請求隨後在冷卻期內被拒絕。只檢查文字與推理增量，不讀取提示詞、工具參數和憑證。
description.en: Interrupts a model reply that keeps repeating short sentences, then rejects identical retries during a cooldown. Only text and reasoning deltas are inspected; prompts, tool arguments and credentials are never read.
How many recent short sentences are considered.

description.zh-CN: 窗口内不同句子不超过这个数就判为复读。
description.zh-TW: 視窗內不同句子不超過這個數就判為複讀。
description.en: A window with at most this many distinct sentences counts as a loop.

description.zh-CN: 中断后，同一请求在这段时间内直接被拒绝。0 表示不冷却。
description.zh-TW: 中斷後，同一請求在這段時間內直接被拒絕。0 表示不冷卻。
description.en: After an interruption, the identical request is rejected for this long. 0 disables the cooldown.

message.zh-CN: 模型在重复短句，这次回复已中断。
message.zh-TW: 模型在重複短句，這次回覆已中斷。
message.en: The model kept repeating short sentences; this reply was interrupted.
